title: TOWARDS REPORTING BIAS IN VISUAL-LANGUAGE DATASETS: BIMODAL AUGMENTATION BY DECOUPLING OBJECT-ATTRIBUTE ASSOCIATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language models on compositionality benchmarks (such as ARO, VG-Relation, and VG-Attribute) to test their ability to correctly associate objects with their specific attributes, distinguishing them from hard negative examples where objects or attributes are swapped.
